about_the_game:
In Tale of Excalibun you as the player discover a magical carrot sword which grants you the power and knowledge to propel your species from the bottom of the food chain!

Wielding this sword you are destined to found a kingdom for rabbit kind and rescue those feeble-minded cottontails from their otherwise mundane demise! Teach them how to survive and how to prosper as the kingdom you found guides you kin's fate.

You must travel across multitude of worlds and bring back bunnies of different specializations. Grant them the knowledge to gain professions and with more bunnies by your side you can grow your base and expand your skill set, reaching further and further to unlock even more levels and bunnies to find!

  • Find and collect 40+ different bunny professionals

  • Unlock and play through 6 different worlds, each with their own sets of levels and bunnies

And enjoy the lovely bunnyous shenanigans!
